content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know the maximum frequency that can be generated by the pulse generator function? I'm interested in whether it operates in seconds or milliseconds. Thanks in advance!

The shortest adjustable value is 0.01 seconds for both low and high periods, resulting in a 0.02 second cycle time. This gives a maximum frequency of 50Hz (1/0.02s). Achieving this is only possible with the actual hardware, not when simulating in the software. The internal maximum frequency may also depend on the program's cycle time, and the output switching frequency can be slower. Please refer to the manual's technical data for more details.
